package section

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// UpdateSectionInput holds update data.
type UpdateSectionInput struct {
	ID                  string
	TechID              *int
	Status              int
	LessonReadAccess    *domain.LessonReadAccess
	LessonReadAccessSet bool
	Translations        []domain.SectionI18n
}

// UpdateSection updates a section.
type UpdateSection struct {
	Sections    repository.SectionRepository
	SectionI18n repository.SectionI18nRepository
	Techs       repository.TechRepository
	I18n        repository.I18nRepository
	Tx          repository.TransactionManager
}

func (uc UpdateSection) Handle(ctx context.Context, in UpdateSectionInput) (*domain.Section, error) {
	var item *domain.Section
	run := func(fn func(ctx context.Context) error) error {
		if uc.Tx != nil {
			return uc.Tx.WithTx(ctx, fn)
		}
		return fn(ctx)
	}
	if err := run(func(ctx context.Context) error {
		var err error
		item, err = uc.Sections.Get(ctx, in.ID)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if in.TechID != nil && *in.TechID > 0 && uc.Techs != nil {
			if _, err := uc.Techs.GetByID(ctx, *in.TechID); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		item.TechID = in.TechID
		item.Status = in.Status
		if in.LessonReadAccessSet {
			if err := domain.ValidateLessonReadAccess(in.LessonReadAccess); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			item.LessonReadAccess = in.LessonReadAccess
		}
		item.UpdatedAt = time.Now().UTC()
		if err := uc.Sections.Update(ctx, *item); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if uc.SectionI18n != nil {
			for _, translation := range normalizeSectionTranslations(in.Translations) {
				if uc.I18n != nil {
					if _, err := uc.I18n.GetByID(ctx, translation.I18nID); err != nil {
						return err
					}
				}
				translation.SectionID = item.ID
				if err := uc.SectionI18n.Upsert(ctx, translation); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
		}
		return nil
	}); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return item, nil
}
